title: Find your research professor
subtitle: Search researchers who are actively publishing on what you care about — from the world's scholarly record.
universityHint: Choose from the list to search one institution.
noResultsBody: Try a broader interest, another spelling, or remove the university filter.
startTitle: Start with something you're curious about
startBody: Try a topic like “protein folding” or “climate policy”, add a university if you have one in mind, and we'll show who is publishing on it.
noteBody: Researchers are ranked by how much they have published on your topic recently, weighted by their standing in the field. Titles like “professor” aren't recorded in scholarly databases, so use the summary and papers to judge fit.
disclaimer: Data from OpenAlex. Affiliations reflect the latest publication records and can lag behind real life.
signInToSave: Sign in to save researchers to your shortlist.
